{{Quote|We now have the coordinates to a secret Separatist weapons factory on Diorda.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]]|<ref name="Versus">{{CWACite|8|Versus (comic story)}}</ref>}}
A secret [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] '''weapons factory''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Diorda]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Sometime during the war, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] business owner [[Mondo-Mod]] came into possession of the weapons factory's coordinates. The Hutt later gave the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] the location of the weapons factory after the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] managed to defeat three of Mondo-Mod's best [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiators]] in the [[Arena of Doom]].
